description: This is a test source file for the TensorFlow Go bindings, specifically for testing the TensorHandle functionality such as creation, data type retrieval, shape, device names, and conversion to Tensor objects.

methods.name: TestNewTensorHandle
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new tensor handle from a tensor.

methods.name: TestTensorHandleDataType
methods.description: Verifies that the DataType method returns the correct type.

methods.name: TestTensorHandleShape
methods.description: Checks if the shape of the tensor handle matches the expected dimensions.

methods.name: TestTensorHandleDeviceName
methods.description: Ensures the device name contains 'CPU', indicating a CPU device.

methods.name: TestTensorHandleBackingDeviceName
methods.description: Checks the backing device name for 'CPU'.

methods.name: TestTensorHandleToTensor
methods.description: Tests converting a tensor handle back to a tensor and verifying its contents.
